title: Sort Records by Field
prompt: Given a list of product dicts with 'name' and 'price', implement cheapest_first(products) returning a new list sorted by ascending price.

tests.name: sorts by price
tests.code:
ps = [{"name": "B", "price": 9}, {"name": "A", "price": 3}]
assert [p["name"] for p in cheapest_first(ps)] == ["A", "B"]

tests.name: input order preserved on ties (stable)
tests.code:
ps = [{"name": "Z", "price": 5}, {"name": "A", "price": 5}]
assert [p["name"] for p in cheapest_first(ps)] == ["Z", "A"], 'stable sort must keep input order for equal prices (not re-tie by name)'
tests.hint: Equal prices keep original order — stable sort.
